kept.title: GitHub - nikicat/rock5b-optee: Upstream OP-TEE with a PKCS#11 token on ...
kept.snippet: Upstream OP-TEE with a built-in PKCS#11 token on a Radxa ROCK 5B (RK3588) that boots edk2-rk3588 UEFI. The goal: a key store whose private keys root cannot read, with import, sign and no export. Physical attacks and secure-boot fusing are out of scope; the known remaining hole is "root rewrites the SPI flash and reboots", which only a fused secure boot closes.
